title: fix(devin): resolve spawn session id via message_nodes fallback
context:
One-shot `devin -p` invocations often skip prompt_history and write
the first user turn straight to message_nodes, leaving spawn->session
matching stuck with a null id. Also fixes millisecond created_at values
being compared against unix-seconds bounds in SQL, which silently
dropped matching rows.
 What changed: added _devin_cli_first_prompt_for_session, test_devin_spawn_session_id_resolved_from_message_nodes; new dep(s): json.
decision: Changed server.py, tests/test_devin_queue.py: added _devin_cli_first_prompt_for_session, test_devin_spawn_session_id_resolved_from_message_nodes; new dep(s): json.
